## Requirement
In the stakeholder's words: who sees what, when, and what done looks like (Given/When/Then).

## Candidates considered
Each existing abstraction you tried (platform nouns from `.platform/docs/ONTOLOGY_DOC_MAP.md`, past decisions in `docs/ontology/decisions.md`), and why it does not fit.

## Proposal
The shape you recommend: which nouns, what is DB-authored, config, code contract or model-led, and the shortcut you are rejecting. Mark anything that needs a platform change as a `platform-request`.

## Blocking
The PR, issue or Linear issue waiting on this. UI may ship on stub data behind a feature gate meanwhile; no migration until this is resolved.
